;Disasters and accidents
*Remnants of a [[Dassault Mirage 2000N/2000D|Dassault Mirage 2000D]] fighter jet are found in [[Jura (department)|Jura]], [[France]], after the aircraft with two pilots onboard disappeared from radar. ;Law and crime
	 
*Diplomatic offices in [[Melbourne]], [[Australia]], are evacuated after suspicious packages were found. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-security/australian-police-investigate-suspicious-packages-sent-to-diplomatic-missions-idUSKCN1P309O (Reuters)]	
*Former [[Cabinet of Israel|Israeli minister]] [[Gonen Segev]] pleads guilty to spying for [[Iran]], in exchange for an 11-year prison sentence. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-iran-espionage/israeli-ex-minister-pleads-guilty-to-spying-for-iran-idUSKCN1P30TW (Reuters)]
*[[Germany|German]] prosecutors say, based on [[Closed-circuit television|CCTV images]], that most of [[Alternative for Germany|AfD]] politician [[Frank Magnitz]]'s injuries yesterday may have been sustained as he hit the ground after having been elbowed once by three people and falling over. Magnitz says the attack may have been an attempted robbery. [https://www.dw.com/en/doubt-cast-over-details-of-attack-on-afd-lawmaker-magnitz/a-47007064 (Deutsche Welle)]
	
;Politics and elections
*[[Brexit negotiations]]
**After a vote by MPs in the [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom|House of Commons]], the government is required to table an alternative [[Brexit]] plan within 3 days of the vote, if it fails to pass a majority on January 15. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-46805269 (BBC News)]
*[[2020 United States presidential election]], [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**Joining several other Democrats in the race, [[United States Senate|Senator]] [[Kamala Harris]] of [[California]] announces her intention for [[Kamala Harris 2020 presidential campaign|running]] in the 2020 United States presidential election. [https://kcbsradio.radio.com/blogs/doug-sovern/harris-ready-enter-race-president-sources-say (KCBS Radio)]

;Science and technology
	 
*[[Havana syndrome]]
**Two biologists who analysed a sound recording obtained by the [[Associated Press]] in 2017, say that it closely matches the [[Mating call|call]]ing [[Stridulation|song]] of the [[Anurogryllus celerinictus|Indies short-tailed cricket]], a species not known to exist in [[Cuba]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/national-security/scientists-say-recording-sound-heard-u-s-diplomats-cuba-matches-n956441 (NBC News)]
	 
*Scientists announce through the [[Nature (journal)|''Nature'']] journal, the discovery of 13 deep-space [[fast radio burst]]s (FRBs), named [[Fast radio burst#FRB 180814|FRB 180814]], by the [[Canadian Hydrogen Intensity Mapping Experiment|CHIME]] radio telescope in [[British Columbia]], [[Canada]].
